entry.title: How to open red chests on Kepler in Destiny 2 Edge of Fate
entry.summary:
Destiny 2: The Edge of Fate's murky new destination Kepler has a lot to discover, including the mysteries of the game's campaign and its new character, Lodi.
As part of the campaign, you will discover more about the people of Kepler, the Aionians, Lodi, and The Nine, who have been a secretive part of Destiny's lore for a decade. This requires lots of exploration, fighting bosses, and clearing out Fallen and Vex enemies.
In your Kepler adventures, though, you will likely come across red destination chests that you can't unlock for a number of different reasons. Here's what we know so far about the red chests on Kepler in Edge of Fate.
How to open red chests on Kepler in Destiny 2 Edge of Fate
Screenshot by Destructoid
So far, there are at least three kinds of chests to unlock, and here's what we know so far about how to unlock them:
"Requires In-depth Knowledge of an Unfamiliar Language"
Unlock Rosetta II and all its upgrades by playing through the campaign.
"Requires undiscovered Fallen tech"
Unlock the Relocator and all its upgrades by playing through the campaign.
"Requires undiscovered technology"
Unlock the Mattermorph and all its upgrades by playing through the campaign.
Once you've gotten done the methods of cracking these chests open, they can be found on the Kepler map by their corresponding icon. You can open them for Kepler armor and weapons, helping you level up in your journey within The Edge of Fate and all of its new content.
The mysteries of The Edge of Fate are still being unraveled at this time, so keep playing and enjoying the story. If you come to a chest you can't open, keep progressing the campaign and come back later and you will eventually find a way to unlock them all.

entry.title: Destiny 2: The Edge of Fate – Does Ikora Rey have a new voice actor?
entry.summary:
Destiny 2: The Edge of Fate is a new direction for the looter shooter game, in more ways than one.
The 2025 expansion for Bungie's FPS brings the fight to a new location called Kepler with a new NPC named Lodi, and it seems to deal with weird space-and-time travel and The Nine. But that's not all that's different.
Upon booting up the DLC for the first time, players quickly noticed that Warlock Vanguard and Destiny 2 mainstay Ikora Rey sounds a lot different this time around, sparking speculation about whether or not the actress behind the character was recast.
Here's everything we know so far about Ikora's voice actress in Destiny 2.
Does Ikora Rey have a new voice actor in Edge of Fate?
Screenshot by Destructoid
Yes, Ikora Rey's voice actor is no longer Mara Junot in The Edge of Fate. Junot has played Ikora Rey in Destiny 2 since 2021, when she took over for the character's original actress, Gina Torres. It appears that a casting change has happened once again.
Who is Ikora's new voice actor in Destiny 2 Edge of Fate?
While unconfirmed, it sounds a lot like Ikora's new actress is Debra Wilson. Wilson is well known for her performances on MadTV but also in video games, including as Prava in Diablo IV, Amanda Waller in Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League, and Doctor in Death Stranding 2, but most players will recognize her voice as the same actress for Savathûn in Destiny 2: The Witch Queen.
It's unclear why the casting change was made, but it may have something to do with the SAG-AFTRA strike. Mara Junot recently posted on her Twitter/X account celebrating that the strike had come to an end, but Ikora's voicelines were likely recorded months ago, so it appears that Wilson took up the mantle in the meantime.

entry.title: How to get all Tatsugiri forms in Pokémon Go
entry.summary:
Tatsugiri has been added to Pokémon Go as part of the Water Festival 2025, giving trainers three different forms to find of the Paldea Pokémon if they are lucky.
It's not a simple case, though, of finding all three in the wild, as Scopely has decided to lock each form behind specific regions. Similarly to what they did with Pokémon like Oricorio, where the four forms can only be found in particular countries and regions.
There are three different forms you can find for Tatsugiri, with each one being unique to different regions across the world. But where do you need to look to find them?
All Tatsugiri form locations in Pokémon Go
Tatsugiri Form Color Location
Curly Form Orange Europe, Middle-East & Africa
Droopy Form Red Americas
Stretchy Form Yellow Asia-Pacific
Tatsugiri's Curly Form (orange) is located in Europe, the Middle East & Africa. The Droopy Form (red) is only found in the Americas. The Stretchy Form (yellow) is only found in the Asia-Pacific region. These Pokémon are also currently not available in the wild and can only be found in one-star raids. They also can't be caught as a Shiny at the time of writing.
Eventually, we imagine Scopely will add the Pokémon to the wild and make their shiny forms available in around a year's time, maybe during a Pokémon Go Fest or similar event. They did the same with Oricorio last year, making each of the forms unique to the various events and increasing the odds of finding a Shiny form of each one.
If you want to get each one, we advise you to use apps like Poké Genie on your phone, which allow trainers to find and join raids across the world. It's what we use to take on regional Pokémon that are exclusive to raids, and is a great resource for any and all future raid-specific Pokémon like this one.

The Jaws Effect is a reasonably well known phenomenon coined in a paper that explores the impact the 1975 film had on Australian policy response to shark bites, although the term is now used a bit more broadly to refer to how sharks are villainised in pop culture - villainisation obviously being an absurdly human and dramatic concept to apply to a hungry or scared fish. Jaws did actually result in an increase in shark culls, but its lasting legacy has also been argued to be more insididous. Depending on whether you're looking at stats from the UN or from conservation charities, the number of sharks killed or mutilated and harvested each year for fins and other parts ranges between about 10 and 100 million, and it's been argued this continues with relatively little pushback as compared to similar wildlife atrocities due to wide-reaching perception that ranges from apathy to vilification. entry.title: USN-7626-3: Git regression

USN-7626-1 fixed vulnerabilities in Git. The updates for CVE-2025-27613 and CVE-2025-46835 caused Gitk and Git GUI to not work properly on Ubuntu 16.04 LTS, Ubuntu 18.04 LTS, Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, and were disabled in USN-7626-2. The problematic updates for the aforementioned CVEs have now been corrected and reinstated in this update.

Original advisory details:
Avi Halachmi discovered that Git incorrectly managed file modification constraints with Gitk. An attacker could possibly use this issue to create or write to arbitrary files on the system. (CVE-2025-27613)
Avi Halachmi discovered that Git incorrectly handled arguments when invoking the Gitk utility. If a user were tricked into cloning a malicious Git repository, an attacker could possibly use this issue to run arbitrary commands. This issue only affected Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.10, and Ubuntu 25.04. (CVE-2025-27614)
Johannes Sixt discovered that Git incorrectly managed file modification constraints with Git GUI. If a user were tricked into editing a file in a malicious Git repository, an attacker could possibly use this issue to create or write to arbitrary files on the system. (CVE-2025-46835)
David Leadbeater discovered that Git incorrectly stripped CRLF characters when editing configuration files. An attacker could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2025-48384)
David Leadbeater discovered that Git incorrectly handled verification when fetching remote Git repositories. An attacker could possibly use this issue to perform protocol injection, leading to arbitrary code execution. This issue only affected Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.10, and Ubuntu 25.04. (CVE-2025-48385)

entry.title: All aboard! The Last Express is ready for testing!
entry.summary: Paris, July 24, 1914. We are excited to announce that Jordan Mechner's acclaimed real-time adventure The Last Express is now ready for testing in ScummVM! Step into the shoes of Robert Cath, an American doctor on the run from murder charges, as he boards the legendary Orient Express for what would be its final journey before the outbreak of World War I. What makes this adventure game truly unique is its time-based gameplay - the game takes place in real time, and characters move within the train following their own schedules, speaking in their native languages, and living their lives whether you're watching or not. But don't worry... you can always rewind time if you missed anything important! To test this game, you'll need the original version of the game (either from the original hybrid DOS/Windows/Mac CDs or from GOG.com) and a daily development build of ScummVM. Please note that the Gold Edition available from Steam is NOT supported - only the original version is compatible at this time. The engine supports the following languages for the game: English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish. We couldn't locate the Japanese version at the moment, but please contact us if you have it! Grab a daily build, have our testing guidelines handy, and get ready for an incredible journey through history, mystery, and one of the most innovative adventure games of the 1990s — and besides... the Orient Express is such a beautiful train, wouldn't you want to take some screenshots while you're there? >
